layout.ENDO: nobs x nvar, exact matrix passed to VARmodel (sentinel 123456789 already mapped to NaN)
layout.IV: nobs x niv, exact matrix passed as VARopt.IV, NaN where the instrument is unavailable
layout.Ft: ntotcoeff x nvar, row 1 constant then lag1 of all vars, lag2 of all vars and so on, column j is equation j
layout.Sigma: nvar x nvar, residual covariance with divisor nobs-ntotcoeff
layout.resid: (nobs-nlags) x nvar, rows start at observation nlags+1
layout.B: nvar x nvar structural impact matrix, column j is shock j, for iv only column 1 is identified and columns 2 onward are zero
layout.IR: nsteps x nvar x nvar, IR(h, i, j) is response of variable i to shock j at horizon h, one std dev shock
